title: Bigglobe Towerinator Compat
body:
I Found this cool new towers mod so decided to try to make a datapack for it to work in BigGlobe this version allows all towers to spawn in the bigglobe's biomes!

Have not done full testing at the moment on all towers but they seem to be spawning fairly ok so far.

Versions: Towerinator V1.1
Bigglobe: (tested on 1.20.1) V5.1.1

FYI this is one of my first datapacks i have made so expect some weirdness. (any help in finding these is most welcome) 

If you find a bug/issue please message me on discord either via bigglobe discord or dm
